summary: Central North Airport Group (OMA) filed a Form 6-K announcing achievement of its Sustainability Performance Target (SPT) under its sustainability-linked bonds. The target was a 58% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 CO2 equivalent per passenger by 2025 vs 2018; OMA achieved an 88% reduction. The announcement is a routine operational update, not a special situation like a merger, activist campaign, or restructuring. No deal terms, board recommendation, or structural changes are disclosed. This is a compliance and ESG update, not a corporate event warranting special-situations classification.
